subject: 'Hidden tribunals': Immigration court due process in tumult with new locations
posts:
Undisclosed locations and last-minute notices are turning immigration courts into hidden tribunals.
Evidence: legal notices, undisclosed venues, remote-only judges
#Aletheia #Immigration

The administration claims scheduling adjustments ensure cases are handled efficiently and lawfully.

Administrative efficiency is weaponized as a pretext to bypass due process and force rapid removals.

- Executive Office for Immigration Review: FAIL (-0.8, -0.9) — Obscures tribunal locations to accelerate removals.

Disguising systemic procedural roadblocks as routine scheduling updates undermines the legitimacy of the entire immigration court system.

Confusing administrative convenience (WHAT) with systemic due process (WHO). The systemic bait-and-switch trades lawful hearings for high-speed deportation metrics.

The Unavoidable Truth: Secretly relocating court dates to non-court buildings effectively guarantees high no-show rates and rapid deportations.

The Unavoidable Lie: Claiming these hidden tribunals are merely neutral scheduling adjustments to reduce court backlogs.
